calculation_steps: Connected weighted Laplacian 4Q has kernel exactly uniform weights, so alpha=w^TQw>0 for every nonuniform w.
G is positive definite (determinant 3/4); SS^T=alpha G is invertible, so R=S^T(SS^T)^-1 exists and SR=I_2.
For arbitrary T PSD, L=RTR^T is PSD, and SLS^T=(SR)T(SR)^T=T.
For uniform w, S=sum_i w_i K_i=0; only the added source channel vanishes.
For positive gamma at a pressure point, arbitrary local gamma slope retains pointwise nonnegativity on a sufficiently small interval.

result.exact_expression: {S(w)L S(w)^T: L symmetric PSD} = PSD_2 for every nonuniform w
result.precision_and_error: symbolic proof and rational witness; no measurement precision
result.scope: pointwise static/low-frequency, unrestricted passive internal bath, archived seven-orbit port
result.physical_interpretation: No uniquely UD residual magnitude or load slope follows without independent bath/source calibration

verification.actual_result: PASS four PSD targets and rank/Gram/cancellation

counterexamples_and_failures: Nonuniform w can still yield zero response when the coupled subspace is lossless.
A first zero-based contrast (1,-1,0,...) has alpha=3/2, not the archived 5/2 example; corrected to (0,1,-1,0,...).
Pointwise passivity does not imply arbitrary derivative at a differentiable exact zero on a two-sided pressure interval.
limitations: Arbitrary PSD L may violate additional measured material and causality constraints; those must be supplied to get a prediction.
The theorem does not cover an arbitrary frequency transfer function or establish microscopic UD coupling.
No new force or load measurement, error model, or independent physics review.
next_discriminant: Independently calibrate coupling and loss, then freeze a signed paired-angle residual and load-slope prediction before held-out force measurements.
